title: Kitap, kitaby
goal: Soften a final k, p or ç before a vowel ending, and keep it before a consonant.

intro.text: Before a vowel ending, the final *k*, *p* or *ç* of a longer word becomes *g*, *b* or *j*: *kitap* → *kitaby*, *çörek* → *çöregi*, *agaç* → *agajy*. Before a consonant it stays: *kitapda*.

exercises.question: How do you write *kitap* with the object ending?

why.1: Before a vowel the *p* of *kitap* becomes *b*: *kitaby*, never *kitapy*.
why.2: *kitap* has back vowels, so the ending is *-y*, not *-i*.
why.3: *kitap* ends in a consonant, so the ending has no *n*; and the *p* becomes *b*.

exercises.explain: *kitap* + *-y*: the *p* softens to *b* before the vowel: *kitaby*.

reject.why: Before a vowel, the *k* of *çörek* becomes *g*: *çöregi*.
**The** bread is a particular one and needs the object ending: *çöregi*.
The last vowel of *çörek* is *e*, a front vowel: *-i*.

exercises.explain: Before a vowel the *ç* of *agaç* becomes *j*: *agaj* + *y* = *agajy*.

reject.why: **The** book is a particular one and takes the ending: *kitaby*.

exercises.explain: *bilet* ends in *t*, and most words in *t* keep it: *bileti*.

exercises.question: *at* means both **name** and **horse**. Which is **the horse** as an object?

why.1: *ady* is the object form of *at*, **name**, which has a long vowel and so softens its *t*.

exercises.explain: One-syllable words usually keep their consonant: *at* (horse) → *aty*. *at* (name) has a long *a* and softens: *ady*.

exercises.en: We're going to school. Aýna is at school.
exercises.explain: Before the vowel of the dative, *p* becomes *b*: *mekdebe*. Before the consonant of the locative it stays: *mekdepde*.

reject.why: Before a vowel the *k* of *çäýnek* becomes *g*: *çäýnegi*.

exercises.explain: *-da* starts with a consonant, so the *p* of *kitap* stays: *kitapda*.

exercises.question: Which is right? **I'm reading the new book.**

why.2: Before the consonant of *-da* the *p* stays, and **reading the book** needs the object ending anyway: *kitaby*.

exercises.explain: *täze kitaby*: a particular book, with *p* → *b* before the vowel.
